Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
